newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-EBRD OKAYS 12 MLN MARK FACILITY FOR UHISPANK.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-EBRD OKAYS 12 MLN MARK FACILITY FOR UHISPANK.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said on Wednesday that it has approved a 12 million mark housing loan to Uhispank .
"The housing finance facility was approved subject to final negotations and signing," an EBRD spokesperson told Reuters.
The secured housing finance facility has a 10-year maturity and is aimed at providing loans for the residential housing industry in Estonia.
Uhispank board member Andrus Kimber told Reuters the bank would not say the interest rate before the loan agreement was signed.
Uhispank hopes the agreement will be signed in the near future, he added.
